scope: Read-only source and schema analysis of the exact reported StoreOperation. No source changes, native execution, private console or private database reads.
source_call_chain: process_event or recover_pending or project_app_server_event enters the existing MatrixRuntime semaphore; the latter two can call recover_pending_locked.
recover_pending_locked iterates this Agent pending inbox records and calls process_inbox_locked.
process_inbox_locked reconciles room/thread and submission identity, then only MatrixSubmissionState::ReconciledTurn calls record_inbox_admitted under the reported operation string.

record_inbox_admitted validates draft identities, begins one SQLx transaction, loads and decodes the existing dispatch, checks state/time/identity, verifies the current room binding including tombstones, verifies thread association, updates the dispatch, appends and trims the change log, then commits.
An already Admitted or Completed exact identity has a separate idempotent commit-and-return path.
Runtime store_operation preserves MatrixDurableError as source; the lower helper unavailable(_error: impl Display) has already discarded its input completely.
what_current_unavailable_does_and_does_n: Within this inspected call chain, Unavailable can arise from SQLx operations or SQLx row decoding. It does not uniquely mean transient storage unavailability.

Invalid local identities or numeric conversions return Invalid. Explicit state/time/idempotency/row-count conflicts return Conflict. Parsed malformed stored identities/states return Corrupt. Missing or mismatched current authority/tombstones return AccessDenied. These explicit branches do not produce this Unavailable display.
No transaction stage, SQLx variant, SQLite result code or underlying error value survives the existing unavailable helper.
The same display can cover acquisition, statement, decode or commit failures; it cannot select busy/lock, schema, constraint, pool closure or corruption as the actual cause.
The operation label contains no event or turn identity. It is not proof that the failing row is exactly the just-started authority message; recovery can examine other pending inbox entries.
The bounded Supervisor sample follows the wait failure. It does not timestamp the durable error relative to queue-start completion or prove continuous preceding process health.
schema_and_transition_review: Migration 0001 explicitly permits admitted/completed state with a non-null prior queued_submission_id: the admitted/completed CHECK requires thread_id and turn_id but does not clear or forbid queue identity.
The normal queued-to-admitted code retains the exact queued_submission_id, verifies both old identity and current binding, and updates state/thread/turn/time in the same transaction.
The inspected schema therefore supplies no deterministic reason to clear queued_submission_id, relax the original state constraints or bypass the admitted-row update.
The existing per-MatrixRuntime semaphore serializes its methods only. This source fact does not prove that every database connection, actor or process is serialized.

next_unit_recommendation.reason: The actual lower error was erased before the retained typed message. No exact failing SQLx site or deterministic schema contradiction was established by this source review.
next_unit_recommendation.minimal_observation_contract: At the original error boundary in this admission call chain, preserve fixed stage plus a closed projection of the actual SQLx error variant and, for recognized database errors only, a bounded validated numeric code. Preserve the original Unavailable result and exact transaction/control flow.
next_unit_recommendation.must_cover_transitive_helpers: An outer admission wrapper seeing only MatrixDurableError is too late. Nested SELECT, row decode, tombstone, thread and append_change failures require context before their original mapping if the diagnostic claims to identify all admission stages.
must_not_emit: Display or Debug of the original error
next_unit_recommendation.fallback: If a code or variant cannot be safely recognized, emit an explicit fixed OTHER/UNKNOWN classification; never use parsing failure as a success or as a reason to reveal the original text.
next_unit_recommendation.execution_status: Proposal only; no diagnostic code, new native or model execution was performed.
